name: Realm
shortDescription: A church management platform from ACS Technologies for people records, giving, communications, reporting, groups, events and multi-campus operations.
suitableContexts: Churches needing an established people and contribution platform
Teams prepared to use a supplier-led trial and pricing conversation

pricing.summary: Realm’s public product pages invite churches to start a free trial and purchase plans, but they do not publish a complete current plan-price schedule. Obtain a written quote that covers modules, implementation, payments and support.

tiers.label: Inform
tiers.detail: Staff data, giving and reporting plan

tiers.label: Connect
tiers.detail: Adds member connection features to Inform

tiers.label: Multiply
tiers.detail: Adds multi-campus administration and outreach features

editorial.assessment: Realm is a substantial US church-management option with a broad people, giving and engagement feature set. Its public price picture is incomplete in this review, so UK churches should establish availability, data processing, payment methods, Gift Aid and total implementation cost before treating it as a viable alternative.
bestFor: Established churches that need a broad people and contribution system
strengths: Free trial and substantial training resources are published
limitations: Complete public pricing is not published
UK commercial, finance and data-processing fit require supplier evidence

longForm.verdict: Realm merits a demo when a church wants an established all-in-one people and giving platform, but it needs a written, UK-specific scope before comparison with locally relevant products.

decisionLens.heading: Ask for the complete operating cost and migration plan.
decisionLens.text: A comprehensive platform often has modules, implementation work and payment arrangements beyond the visible plan names. Map the current data, giving, reports and volunteer workflows before deciding whether a full migration is justified.

sections.heading: People, giving and engagement
sections.question: Can the church establish its full workflow and commercial fit?
paragraphs: Realm describes people profiles, contributions, pledges, reporting, groups, events and communications. Its Inform, Connect and Multiply pages describe increasing scope, and the supplier offers a free trial.
Use the trial to test one ordinary member journey and a finance report. Before importing live records, request current UK availability, contract, hosting, payment and Gift Aid details in writing.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on Realm’s official product and support pages.
themes: The platform is broad enough to require workflow-level evaluation.
Unpublished total pricing and UK fit are key research gaps.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier claims are not independent testing or confirmation that Realm is commercially available for UK churches.

faq.question: Does Realm offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Realm’s Inform product page advertises a free trial.

faq.question: How much does Realm cost?
faq.answer: A complete current public plan-price schedule is not published. Ask ACS Technologies for a written quote including modules, implementation and payment costs.

faq.question: Does Realm support UK Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Ask the supplier for evidence covering the required UK declaration, claim and reconciliation workflow.

seo.title: Realm review for UK churches
seo.description: Independent Realm profile for UK churches: trial, people and giving tools, pricing gaps and UK due diligence.
